setup.description: Onboarding — locates/creates the Drive personal-assistant root and collects required fields for every registered capability.

log.description: Captures a structured entry (idea, task, observation, etc.) into the persistent log for later recall during planning and decision-making.

add-log-field.description: Registers a new log field/category in the log schema so future log entries can use it.

add-func.description: Adds a new capability to personal-assistant — registers it in modules.json and scaffolds its skill file.
